description:
Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you love solving complex problems and want your work to make a difference?
Sound like you? Keep reading.
At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters.  
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.  
  • Human touch – We care deeply.  

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

Why join Semble?

  • Be part of something big: join a mission-driven company transforming healthcare
  • Work with exceptional people: you’ll be surrounded by a smart, ambitious, and supportive team with a great team culture
  • Growth opportunities: join a company on an exciting growth journey, with ample opportunity for professional development.


The role
We’re hiring a mid-level OutSystems engineer to join our Technical Solutions team. You’ll build and maintain customer applications and extensions using OutSystems 11 (O11), connecting them to Semble and other systems through APIs. Solutions could include customer portals, operational applications and workflows that address specific healthcare needs.

You’ll take part in delivery from solution design through development, testing, go-live and ongoing improvement. You’ll work with Customer Success, Implementation, Product and Engineering, and collaborate with external delivery partners.

You’ll contribute to application architecture decisions, help maintain one of our existing applications, take part in code reviews and share your O11 knowledge to help upskill the Technical Solutions team. Practical experience delivering and supporting O11 applications is essential.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain responsive Reactive Web applications in Service Studio, including screens, reusable Blocks, business logic and data models. Use OutSystems UI and appropriate JavaScript, HTML and CSS to deliver accessible user experiences.
  • Follow Architecture Canvas principles to keep applications modular, separating user interfaces, business services and shared components. Help identify and improve tightly coupled modules.
  • Build and consume REST APIs to connect OutSystems with Semble and third-party systems. Handle authentication, data mapping, validation, timeouts and errors, following agreed patterns for retries and duplicate prevention.
  • Implement background processing using O11 Timers, and use Business Process Technology where a process needs it, with clear error handling and logging.
  • Model data and optimise Aggregates and SQL queries. Investigate slow screens and excessive server calls, and flag performance risks as usage grows.
  • Apply secure development practices, including server-side authorisation, record-level access checks, secure API access and careful handling of patient data. Keep sensitive information out of browser storage and diagnostic logs.
  • Test your own work, including integration testing, and support customer UAT. Prepare deployments through LifeTime together with the team, checking dependencies and configuration.
  • Use Service Center, application logs and debugging tools to investigate production issues and fix root causes.
  • Document your solutions and interfaces, take part in code reviews and share your O11 knowledge with colleagues through pairing and knowledge sessions.


What we are looking for

  • Solid hands-on OutSystems 11 experience, with at least two applications delivered to production. You can explain your design choices and what you learned from real projects.
  • Good Reactive Web development skills: screen lifecycle, Client and Server Actions, reusable Blocks, events, validation and data fetching. You understand what belongs on the client and what must be enforced on the server.
  • Working knowledge of Service Studio, LifeTime and Service Center, including debugging, versioning and deploying applications across development, test and production environments.
  • Good relational data modelling skills, with practical knowledge of Entities, Aggregates, SQL and transactions.
  • Experience consuming and exposing REST APIs, working with JSON and implementing authentication. You can investigate integration errors and handle them predictably.
  • Care for security, testing and maintainability. You take data protection seriously and can apply secure development practices in a healthcare setting.
  • Clear communication in English with customers and non-technical colleagues, and a willingness to share knowledge with the team.


Nice to haves

  • OutSystems certification relevant to O11 development, such as Associate or Professional Reactive Developer; experience with AI Mentor Studio for reviewing application quality.
  • Integration Studio and C#/.NET extensions, SOAP integrations, or O11 Mobile development.
  • Experience consuming GraphQL APIs from OutSystems. Our current applications use GraphQL, so solid REST experience is enough to get started, with existing examples in the codebase to learn from.
  • Experience writing automated tests for your own logic, for example with BDDFramework.
  • Experience with healthcare or regulated SaaS, multi-tenant applications, SSO and identity providers, or interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7.
  • Familiarity with OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC), Workato or similar integration platforms, and responsible use of AI tools to support development.
  • Experience using AI coding agents such as Claude with OutSystems 11 MCP in Service Studio, including reviewing agent changes through Compare and Merge.


What you’ll get in return 

  • Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s why we hire you! 
  • Work alongside an inspiring team – our founders started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field. 


Diversity and inclusion 

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including groups traditionally underrepresented in technology. We encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.
